Class RestoredGameManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.gamemanager.GameManager
it.polimi.ingsw.model.gamemanager.RestoredGameManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
ApplicableActions, Snapshotable
public class RestoredGameManager extends GameManager
A GameManager that restores a previously saved match from a GameSnapshot.

The constructor rebuilds the full game state (deck, board, queue, players, phase, pending actions, etc.) from the snapshot via GameState(GameSnapshot, List), then re-establishes tile-to-player object references that are broken by JSON deserialization via reconnectTilePlayers(List). Once constructed, resume() broadcasts the restored state to all connected clients so they can resync their views.

  • Constructor Details

    • RestoredGameManager

      public RestoredGameManager(GameSnapshot snapshot, List<ModelObserver> observers, Runnable onGameEndedCallback)
      Constructs a RestoredGameManager from a saved snapshot.

      The full game state is reconstructed from snapshot via GameState(GameSnapshot, List), after which tile-to-player object references (broken by JSON deserialization) are repaired by reconnectTilePlayers(List). The current phase is then resolved from GameSnapshot.getCurrentPhase().

      Parameters:
      snapshot - the snapshot to restore from; must not be null
      observers - the list of observers for the restored match; must not be null
      onGameEndedCallback - callback invoked when the match ends; must not be null

      Broadcasts the restored game state to all connected clients so that they can resync their views after reconnecting.

    • reconnectTilePlayers

      private void reconnectTilePlayers(List<Player> savedPlayers)
      Re-establishes player references for all tiles on the board and in the queue after deserialization from a GameSnapshot.

      Jackson deserializes tiles and players independently, leaving tile-to-player object references broken. This method repairs them by matching the nickname stored in each tile against the deserialized player list.

      Parameters:
      savedPlayers - the list of deserialized players from the snapshot
